activities.name: Wish
activities.note: Standard uses (safe): duplicate any spell of 8th level or lower, ignoring components. Otherwise, alter reality per DM ruling — examples include granting one creature resistance to a damage type, removing all curses/contagions/poisons, restoring up to 20 creatures to full HP, granting +1 to AC and saves to up to 10 creatures for 8 hours, or undoing a single recent event. Open-ended wishes carry the standard stress: 33% chance per non-spell-duplicating wish that you can never cast Wish again, plus 1d10 levels of Exhaustion and other penalties per the 2024 SRD. v0 cannot model open-ended magic — surfaces as a note only.
